'''T6-44''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was tasked with delivering supplies to the [[Thul research camp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], but [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] attacked and stole the supplies. T6-44 then recruited Imperial forces to recover the supplies.<ref name="TOR" />
